mapper.sql: ID as id, MEMBER_ID as memberId, TENANT_REF_ID as tenantRefId, USER_REF_ID as userRefId, STATUS as status, IS_DELETE as isDelete, CREATED_TIME as createdTime, CREATOR_ID as creatorId, MODIFY_TIME as modifyTime, MODIFIER_ID as modifierId, DELETED_AT as deletedAt, DELETED_BY_REF_ID as deletedByRefId, VERSION as version
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PEACH_TENANT_MEMBER (ID, MEMBER_ID, TENANT_REF_ID, USER_REF_ID, STATUS, IS_DELETE, CREATED_TIME, CREATOR_ID, MODIFY_TIME, MODIFIER_ID, VERSION) VALUES (#{id}, #{memberId}, #{tenantRefId}, #{userRefId}, #{status}, 0, #{createdTime}, #{creatorId}, #{modifyTime}, #{modifierId}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM PEACH_TENANT_MEMBER WHERE USER_REF_ID = #{userRefId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND IS_DELETE = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE PEACH_TENANT_MEMBER SET STATUS = #{status}, MODIFY_TIME = #{modifyTime}, MODIFIER_ID = #{modifierId}, VERSION = VERSION + 1 WHERE ID = #{id} AND TENANT_REF_ID = #{tenantRefId} AND VERSION = #{version} AND IS_DELETE = 0

UPDATE PEACH_TENANT_MEMBER SET STATUS = 'LEFT', IS_DELETE = 1, DELETED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), DELETED_BY_REF_ID = #{operatorRefId}, VERSION = VERSION + 1 WHERE ID = #{id} AND TENANT_REF_ID = #{tenantRefId} AND VERSION = #{version} AND IS_DELETE = 0

UPDATE PEACH_TENANT_MEMBER SET STATUS = 'ACTIVE', IS_DELETE = 0, DELETED_AT = NULL, DELETED_BY_REF_ID = NULL, VERSION = VERSION + 1 WHERE ID = #{id} AND TENANT_REF_ID = #{tenantRefId} AND VERSION = #{version} AND IS_DELETE = 1
